paragraphs: Chapter 1036
Episode 249. The First Deployment of the Plutonian (3)
Vahn nodded with an expression as light as if she were going out for a stroll.
“Exactly, my intuition was right. We’ll go, kill, and return.”
As Vahn briskly rose from her seat,
“Wait, Sister Vahn. Are you saying you’re going right now?”
“That’s right.”
Jin and his companions were momentarily speechless, looking at her.
This wasn’t a mere hunt for a common pack of monsters.
They were going to eradicate one of the Black Sea's Five Kings, a monster that once nearly brought the world to an apocalypse.
Of course, that was the story of Gliek, but it was certain the other Kings of the Black Sea also possessed terrifyingly destructive power.
Jin and his colleagues thought of Gliek, while Luna thought of Kial, shivering with fear.
“Your decision seems too hasty, Sister Vahn.”
“Lightning is fast.”
“Pardon?”
“And the Plutonians are lightning. So, I am the fastest among the Plutonians.”
It was Vahn’s attempt at humor. Only Ameris and Eltiot chuckled.
“I’ve noticed during our time together that you have a surprisingly good sense of humor.”
“Ha, quite a witty joke. Our Plutonian's humor has indeed been well passed down to future generations.”
“…I see, brother. I didn’t know that.”
“It’s alright. After all, Brother Jin is the second fastest person.”
“Hold on, hold on. Sister Vahn, the Black Sea's Five Kings are not so easy to deal with. Even the expedition members, including myself, and even father risked our lives…”
“Didn’t the expedition quickly subdue the second king of the Black Sea, Su? I heard Chiron Runcandel, your father, completely overwhelmed him.”
But can’t I do it too?
That was the expression on Vahn’s face.
It wasn't an intention to belittle Chiron, but rather a natural expression of someone who had always been an absolute being.
Jin, Luna, and the companions were inevitably engulfed in a strange feeling.
They had never even imagined someone comparing themselves to Chiron Runcandel and thinking in such a manner.

“Of course, Chiron might be stronger than I am now, so he could have overwhelmed Su. But what’s important now isn’t whether he or I am superior. The enemy is using a dangerous, unknown monster. So the safest person should go and handle it. That’s all that matters.”
Jin was persuaded.
Right now, the best choice to deal with an enemy like the ‘Black Sea Five Kings’ was Vahn and the Plutonians.
Adding Genesis members like Jin, Luna, and Murakan would be ideal, but it was wartime.
Moreover, the recently read letter included that Zipfel had acquired ‘a power beyond imagination’, so the core forces had to be distributed well.
“So, I will go and subdue Nirgand as quickly as possible.”
In the end, Jin nodded.
“You’re right, Sister Vahn.”
“As expected of the second fastest among us.”
“So, how will the dispatch team be arranged?”
“All members of the Plutonians except for Brother Boras, and the Golden Airship. With this, no matter how powerful the Black Sea Five Kings are, it won’t be a problem. And…”
For a moment, Vahn’s eyes darkened with killing intent.
He was thinking of the Sun God Religon’s high priest ‘Luke’, who tried to use Nirgand and threatened Jin.
“Those who tarnish the honor of the Plutonians and dared to threaten Brother Jin will not be spared.”
Going after Nirgand meant a potential battle with the Sun God Religon as well.
In other words, Vahn intended to kill Nirgand and all the risen ancestors of the Sun God Religon.
“I understand. It’s regrettable that I cannot accompany you on this mission to punish those who have dishonored the name of the Plutonians.”
Vahn smiled softly at Jin’s remark and glanced at his waist.
Jin immediately understood her gaze and unfastened Sigmund, handing it over to Vahn.
“This sword is practically Brother Jin himself. So, let it ease your disappointment a bit. Show those scoundrels the power of the Plutonians.”
“Understood. But please be careful.”
“I will.”
The preparation for the departure began immediately.
As the 76 members of the Plutonians, excluding Boras, boarded the Golden Airship, Peitel greeted them with a nervous sweat.
[Um, ahem…! My, Plutonians. I have h-heard. To the Black Sea… you're heading to the Black Sea?]
Peitel's stuttering wasn’t due to fear of the Black Sea or Nirgand.
He was terrified of Vahn and the Plutonians, as he had been when Jin was active in the Blue Bird Island, even afraid of Sigmund.
He knew how they had fought against the gods during the ‘Final War’ half a millennium ago.
Especially Vahn, even after several conversations over the past six days, just facing him made Peitel feel breathless.
“Peitel.”
[Y-Yes, G-Great Leader…!]
“Great Leader? The only leader of the alliance is Brother Jin. Are you Jet?”
[No, I’m sorry.]
“Let's forget the past. We are now fellow alliance members, so don’t feel too uncomfortable around me.”
[I-Is that so?]
“Yes. But if you ever make cowardly or despicable choices like before, things will be different.”
[Oh, how could I? I am loyal to the leader. Well, I don’t have a body anymore, but anyway, I would never do that.]
“Excellent. Brothers, today is our first day coming out to the Human World to fight for Brother Jin. It’s time to get to work. Are you all ready?”
“Yes!”
“Let’s go. Our target is the outskirts of the Black Sea, the former capital of the Sarba Kingdom.”
It was the area where Jin had met Ozdok in the past.
Peitel immediately set the spatial leap coordinates to that location.
Wooong…!
The power source of the airship, the luminous heart/heart of light, vibrated from its core.
Its output was already the best in the Human World, and the alliance had significantly advanced the Golden Airship after the Red Plutonian war.
Thanks to Boras and the technology derived from analyzing the equipment of the Red Plutonians, combined with the power of the Plutonians, it was greatly enhanced.
[Wow! With Lord Vahn and the Plutonians on board, the power feels different! At this rate, it could even tear apart a sky fortress!]
The power did not falter even as it opened a long-distance dimensional gate leading directly to the Black Sea.
Like the Plutonians receiving the resonance of their Battle God power, the airship’s power source was also enhanced. After all, its power source was made from a luminous heart.
[Let’s gooo!]
Whoosh!
The Golden Airship entered the dimensional gate.
After a while, in a landscape as white as a different world’s snowy field, the Plutonians faced the scenery of the outskirts of the Black Sea.
Peitel was excited to enter the Black Sea immediately.
However, upon arrival, Vahn decided to keep the Golden Airship on standby on the outskirts of the Black Sea.
“Baltirock, Baba, Kaio brothers. Only you three come out with me. The rest will stay here, ready for any other unforeseen situations.”
“Yes, Battle God Brother!”
As strong as each member of the Plutonians might be, entering a mysterious area like the Black Sea in a group wasn’t a wise decision.

It would have been better not to have any ordinary warriors with them, especially if they were to engage in fierce battle with the likes of Nirgand and Luke. They were not in their prime anymore, commanding tens of thousands of ordinary warriors.
“Sister Beliz.”
“Speak, Sister Goddess of Battle.”

“While we enter the Black Sea, you will have command. There might be chaos spirits or monsters emerging from the battles and heading towards the Human World. Patrol the entire outskirts of the Black Sea with the Golden Airship and respond accordingly.”
“Understood.”
The bridge was opened.
Vahn spent a moment gazing at the dark landscape of the Black Sea visible beyond the bridge.
She felt it.
The enemies were trying to escape from the Black Sea, from a very deep place far away.
It was a realm only Vahn could perceive.
“Let's go, brothers.”
Vahn and three other Battle Kings jumped from the bridge and approached the entrance of the Black Sea.
All the monsters living at the entrance sensed their approach, precisely Vahn’s entry into the Black Sea.
Since Chiron first visited the Black Sea decades ago.
For the monsters of the Black Sea, Chiron and the aura he emitted had become an imprint of terror.
This imprint had been passed down almost genetically, even to monsters who had never personally seen Chiron.
Now, a new fear was being added to the monsters' instincts. With each step Vahn took, the hiding monsters retreated.
The sea of monsters was parting for Vahn.
Vahn deliberately did not speed up. She was trying to locate subtle traces and directions of the enemies.
Soon, Vahn figured out the movement of the enemies.
“The enemies are moving very fast. It seems there are a large number of dimensional gates or similar entities formed throughout the Black Sea. Probably the sorcery of those Sun God Religon people.”
“What should we do, Battle God Brother?”
Instead of answering, Vahn pointed towards the far left.
Kaio immediately understood and raised his senses, shooting a divine arrow precisely at the location Vahn indicated.
Fizzz!
A blue arrow flew a long distance before embedding in something. It was one of the dimensional gates Vahn mentioned.
“First, we proceed by eradicating the dimensional gates they can use. If we’re lucky and they manage to escape us and reach here, it’ll become troublesome.”
The plan was to reduce the number of passageways close to the Human World, increasing the chance of encountering the enemy through the remaining routes. That was Vahn’s strategy.
As soon as the first gate was destroyed, the three Battle Kings dispersed and wielded their weapons.
A bow and two long swords unleashed unceasing lightning.
Vahn slowly advanced, striking lightning at the locations of dimensional gates his brothers might have missed.
It took less than 10 minutes to clear most nearby dimensional gates.
When the scattered Battle Kings returned, Vahn was inspecting the last remaining gate.
“As expected, it’s a dimensional gate using chaos spirits.”
It was a gate that could severely irradiate anyone without chaos spirit immunity, but this didn’t apply to the Plutonians.
Without hesitation, Vahn and the Battle Kings entered the gate.
The dimensional gate led to the early section of the Black Sea's midpoint.
As they were now closer, Vahn felt Nirgand’s power more distinctly than before.
“The one who was moving quickly has suddenly stopped. He must have realized we are coming…”
Despite the considerable distance, Vahn seemed to see it. Nirgand’s figure shrinking in unexpected fear.
With a soft voice, Vahn proclaimed to them.
“The time for annihilation has come, enemies of Brother Jin.”
